name: basic-worker-test-0bffe305fe/worker-async-send-negative-e
spec_references: ## Statements: supported statement list includes Compound Assignment and Foreach, but does not include named worker declarations or worker send statements.
## Expressions: "[Start action]", "[Wait action]" are listed; worker send and receive actions are not listed.
reason: The negative cases require named workers and asynchronous worker messaging, which subset 10 does not cover. Although foreach and compound assignment are supported, rejecting async sends in their expression positions depends on unsupported worker messaging grammar/behavior.
unsupported_constructs: Named worker declarations (worker w1 / worker w2)
test_design_notes: Both cases mark the async send used as an expression with @error; there are no @args, @panic, or @output assertions.
